files.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-18 (Phase 4 research, D-11). WordPress + Modern Events Calendar Lite. 13 application/ld+json blocks; 12 carry one top-level schema.org Event each (all @type "Event", no subtypes), plus WebSite/BreadcrumbList/Organization blocks. startDate/endDate are ISO 8601 with offsets: +01:00 up to 23 Oct, +00:00 from 25 Oct (BST ends). Every event has eventStatus https://schema.org/EventScheduled and eventAttendanceMode https://schema.org/OfflineEventAttendanceMode, location @type Place with name and a free-text address (some with NR18 postcodes, some empty name and address), organizer @type Person, offers.url, and names with HTML entities (’, &). Redacted: all emails (including Wymondham Town Council role addresses and a form placeholder) to redacted@example.invalid, phone numbers to 01632 960000, private first names in organizer Person nodes and one description to [name removed]. JSON-LD still parses after redaction (13/13 blocks). Visit Wymondham is a filter (regional) source: most events pass the geofence through NR18 or the Wymondham place name.
